policies.title: Commonwealth of Dominica ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Bosnia and Herzegovina government guidance names Dominica in the general visa-free rule and states the general visa-free stay limit.
conditions: Use the Commonwealth of Dominica regular passport from the national passport service. Current BiH government guidance lists Dominica among citizens who do not require a visa.
The general visa-free stay is up to 90 days in a six-month period. This does not transfer the treatment of emergency, travel-permit, collective, seaman, diplomatic or official documents.

policies.title: Commonwealth of Dominica ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the Commonwealth of Dominica regular passport from the national passport service. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.
Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current document does not identify a Dominica ordinary-passport exception; this is medium confidence.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Commonwealth of Dominica regular passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present it for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Commonwealth of Dominica ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Use the Commonwealth of Dominica regular passport from the national passport service; the live asset excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register using the Commonwealth of Dominica regular passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
